attainment_rule: A checked incumbent attains a target when its raw gap is at most the target. Missing incumbents do not attain any target.
aggregation: Equal instance weights, with equal trial weights within each instance. All scheduled cells remain in the denominator.
deliverables: Mean squeezed-gap and raw-gap target-attainment curves at all frozen targets.
Reported computational-closure attainment and restricted mean closure time, with checked witnesses and native guard qualifications.
Mean compatible primal-dual residual (U - L) / U, with explicit missing-pair convention and bound availability.
Aligned per-instance status matrix with trial proportions or labelled trial panels and separate failure/guard annotations.
deliverable_scope: Bound-residual, availability and status-matrix figures are main-analysis deliverables, not pilot-completion or main-launch gates.
